BJP Appoints Deepak Mhaskey as New Social Media Head, Replacing Amit Malviya

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has appointed Deepak Mhaskey as its new national social media convenor, replacing Amit Malviya. Mhaskey, described as a chemistry professor, will lead the party's social media operations. Malviya's departure from the role follows reports of internal disagreements and lobbying within the party's state units. Mhaskey stated his focus will be on countering opposition narratives and utilizing platforms like Instagram Reels.
